Resolves #21624

`examples/gantt/taskEditor`: a website relaunch planned in sixteen linked tasks over four phases, each with its percent done drawn in its bar. A task opens in the timeline's editor by double-click or by Enter on its bar, and the toolbar names both. A later end moves the task and every task linked after it, a saved percent fills the bar, an end before the start is refused with its message, and Escape or Cancel changes nothing and hands focus back to the task.

Evidence: L3 (headless Chromium e2e on the example: the cascade, the fill, the refusal, focus back on Escape and Cancel, the phone's task column, the dark start, every theme at both sizes; frames) → L3 required (a new example's behaviour and look). Residual: none.

| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | CI-covered: `test/playwright/e2e/gantt/TaskEditorNL.spec.mjs` › "the editor opens on a task by double-click and by Enter, and Escape hands focus back to it". The two ways: double-click a bar, or focus it and press Enter |
| AC-2 | CI-covered: same spec › "a later end moves the task and every task linked after it", "a saved percent fills the bar", and "… Cancel then changes nothing and hands focus back"; Escape is in AC-1's test |
| AC-3 | CI-covered: same spec › "an end before the start is refused with a message …"; the message is in the refused frame below |
| AC-4 | CI-covered: the later-end test asserts that `home` starts on 2027-03-22, a week later, through to `announce` |

## Test Evidence

Frames: `0138b70652` merged locally with `dev` `b10c77bdbe`, which carries #21727; `neo-theme-neo-dark`. `9b1202433f`, after it, changes only the spec.

![First frames beside gantt/basic](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/ee6365b316875cfe85df8eb41137c0f00bc403f8/review-evidence/21624/first-frames.png?raw=true)
![The task editor's states](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/ee6365b316875cfe85df8eb41137c0f00bc403f8/review-evidence/21624/editor-states.png?raw=true)

Frame critique: the cold look's findings (R1, R2 below) are folded in.
- **Fixed this round:** at 390 the task column is 160 px, not 240, and the chart gets the 80 px; the hint is a pill in the title's colour, no longer small low-contrast text; the refused message reads on one line under End, from #21727.
- **Kept:** a bar narrower than 95 px drops its title, by this example's `@container` rule, since the task column names every row (R1, R2: 8 of 16 bars, two titles cut short). The teal is the done part and the subtitle says "progress on 12 March"; the chart has no legend (R2; the timeline's, out of scope). Small type (R1, R2) and links crossing between Design and Build (R1) come from the Gantt theme and the plan. The strip under the last row is the window's height past sixteen rows (R2). After the save the plan runs past the right edge, and summary bars keep their stored dates when the cascade moves their tasks past them (the roll-up gap named on #21346). The editor writes dd.mm.yyyy beside an English axis and keeps 00:00 on a day-scale plan (the shared editor's fields). On the phone the subtitle gives way to the hint, and the first week shows: the rest of the plan, 12 March included, is a swipe away, and a phone shows no scrollbar before the swipe (R1, R2).
- **Engine:** at 160 px the tree cuts titles mid-word without an ellipsis (R1, R2; defect-note `fa4d5f0a`).
- **Open:** on the phone the hint names double-click and Enter (R1). It names only what the spec proves; whether a double tap opens the editor needs a touch device.
- Not this PR: `gantt/basic`'s title bar runs past the right edge at 390, as released.

None left: the frames were retaken on `dev` with #21727, and the hint and the phone's task column changed in this round.
